title: Intrinsically disordered regions in the yeast transcriptional regulator Ixr1 support prion-like behavior.
authors: Barreiro-Alonso, Aida; Rey-Souto, Cora; Lamas-Maceiras, Monica; Perez-Martinez, Jose Manuel; Franco-Gacio, Anahir; Rodriguez-Belmonte, Esther; Cerdan, M Esperanza; Vizoso-Vazquez, Angel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母转录调控因子Ixr1的内在无序区及其类朊病毒行为，并利用AI辅助建模预测其与Ssn8的互作，虽涉及TF-DNA结合域但核心聚焦蛋白聚集与互作，而非TF-DNA结合机制。
abstract: Ixr1 is a yeast transcriptional regulator previously identified as a player in the response to stress conditions, such as oxidative stress, hypoxia, iron limitation or DNA damage. Little is known about the structure of the Ixr1 protein apart from their HMG-boxes, which conform two well-known folded DNA binding domains. Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) are predicted in Ixr1 by algorithms and analytical methods. Ixr1 protein is non-globular and prone to aggregation, sustaining a concentration-dependent equilibrium between monomeric and dimeric forms. Treatment with 150 microM glutaraldehyde, to stabilize and fix weak protein-protein interactions, induces Ixr1 to form large oligomers. Indeed, Ixr1 forms amyloids as demonstrated both by in vitro and in vivo approaches. Chimeras constructed between Ixr1 and the C-terminal domain of Sup35, which provides the translation termination function to the yeast prion [PSI(+)], show that IDRs from Ixr1 substitute the N-terminal region of Sup35 that is responsible of its priogenic nature. Finally, Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted modeling of Ixr1 with Ssn8 (Srb11), which was already identified as a protein interacting with Ixr1 and related to yeast stress response, reveals that their interaction might diminish the disordered/priogenic nature of Ixr1 and increase the Ixr1 folding in the heterodimer.
abstract_zh: Ixr1是一种酵母转录调控因子，先前已被鉴定为应对应激条件（如氧化应激、低氧、铁限制或DNA损伤）的参与者。关于Ixr1蛋白的结构，除了其HMG-boxes（构成两个已知的折叠DNA结合域）外，知之甚少。通过算法和分析方法预测Ixr1中存在内在无序区域（IDRs）。Ixr1蛋白呈非球状且易于聚集，维持着单体与二聚体形式之间的浓度依赖性平衡。用150微摩尔戊二醛处理以稳定和固定弱蛋白-蛋白相互作用，可诱导Ixr1形成大的寡聚体。事实上，体外和体内方法均证明Ixr1形成淀粉样蛋白。在Ixr1与Sup35的C端结构域（为酵母朊病毒[PSI(+)]提供翻译终止功能）之间构建的嵌合体表明，Ixr1的IDRs替代了Sup35中负责其朊病毒性质的N端区域。最后，人工智能（AI）辅助建模Ixr1与Ssn8（Srb11）的相互作用（Ssn8已被鉴定为与Ixr1相互作用且与酵母应激反应相关的蛋白）揭示，它们的相互作用可能减弱Ixr1的无序/朊病毒性质，并增加异二聚体中Ixr1的折叠。
